origin: Recovered original Opt generators. Eight base workload pairs reproduce the original sources byte-for-byte; the counter MeTTa program was corrected as recorded in counter-correction.json. All original MM2 baseline inputs are unchanged.
scope: Original Opt application suite, not the MORK-backed MM2 front end.
measurements: 3 fresh-process trials per engine/case; shared Ryzen 7 9800X3D Linux workstation, logical CPU 15; no --timing (which adds timing facts). MORK execution summary excludes loading/dump; wall includes complete CLI job. CeTTa/SWI publish counts; MORK publishes its store.

qualification.independent_oracles: Python bit sets for both graph sizes; independent clique enumeration and integer counter simulation.

counter_and_scale_stack.stack_limit: unlimited for every engine in counter and scale jobs
counter_and_scale_stack.reason: default-stack MORK counter run aborted before completion
